text:
anya: hi all, anya here (prod mgr) starting today. quick org question: who is the canonical owner for cross-team incident escalation when a customer reports a model-related outage that also has potential data/privacy exposure? want to bookmark the escalation chain and who to page for legal/compliance + executive alerts.

oliver (eng-platform): welcome Anya :wave: for service ownership we use the owners page in Confluence (Team Directory -> Service Owners) and the owners API. in cross-team cases the flow is: primary service PD -> SRE -> product EM -> legal/security if data exposure. oliver: i'll DM the owners link and the owners.json API.

marcus (sre): short practical flow: 1) if customer-impacting page the service PD immediately, 2) if you don't have PD access post a "coverage request" in #eng-oncall, 3) once SRE acked, we do initial containment. if suspected data leak, we escalate to security@redwood.com and cc legal.

mira (legal): legal here  for any potential data/privacy exposure, page legal@redwood.com and @mira. we triage and advise on disclosure obligations, NDAs, and regulator notices. please include: service, scope, customer id (if any), and timeline. we aim to respond within 1 business hour for incident escalations.

support-lead: @anya for customer communication SLAs, loop in support@redwood.com ASAP. we coordinate external updates with product and legal. if it's a P0 we use the incident template (link in Confluence) for status updates.

people-ops: adding that exec notifications follow our incident severity matrix. after SRE+PM confirm P0, the EM or PM should notify the oncall exec (cto-oncall). people-ops keeps the exec contact rota up to date.

cto-oncall: if you need exec-level visibility, page me and include summary + current mitigation. I'll engage the CEO/CSO if needed. for legal/privacy ones, mirror legal@redwood.com in the page.

devex-bot: Incident escalation checklist created: IC-20260615-7. Links: owners page, incident template, PD escalation runbook.

anya: super helpful, thanks everyone. one more: who owns the customer contract/POC notes if support asks for contractual context?

oliver (eng-platform): contract/POC owner usually lives with the account's CS or Sales; support will flag and we'll escalate to the assigned CS. owners.json also has a `business_owner` field for customer-facing services.

mira (legal): if you need contract scans quickly, legal maintains a contract index; ping legal@redwood.com with the customer name and we'll surface the POC/contact.

anya: perfect, bookmarking these. appreciate the quick orientation :thumbsup:
